strings.en:
{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Eve 】{0b:09}
What a parade of tired lines.{1a}If stock phrases are all that come to
mind, you needn't force your mouths
open, you know.{1a}I've heard them all before, they're stale,
I can guess the next line, and above all,
they're no fun to listen to.{1a}Or do you find some formal beauty in
those patterned lines of yours? As if to
say, "These are the words of a
real man."{1a}If so, the words that come out when you
lose would naturally be "You'll pay for

strings.tl: What a parade of tired lines. // If stock phrases are all that come to mind, you needn't force your mouths open, you know. // I've heard them all before, they're stale, I can guess the next line, and above all, they're no fun to listen to. // Or do you find some formal beauty in those patterned lines of yours? As if to say, "These are the words of a real man." // If so, the words that come out when you lose would naturally be "You'll pay for this!", I suppose.
Y-you bitch... // Just 'cause you're a woman don't mean we'll go easy on ya. Get outside!!

strings.en:

It would make me terribly angry, if you thought that.
